tags.bug: Fixed an issue with the broken shortsword's visual model disappearing sometimes.
Fixed an issue with alcohol (or other trinkets) in inventory sometimes preventing the player from swimming over Seine.
Fixed an issue with an error message about crossbow drum magazine popping up during the prison escape section in French campaign.
Fixed a bunch of smaller issues in the king's route section and updated its formula for determining the outcome of pitched battles.
Fixed a bug that prevented Arsenal from spawning soldiers during the war against the anti-Venice coalition.

Fixed a bug that happened when the player attempted to hand over men to the besieged Venetian fortress; the men now can only be given if you sneaked into the fortress instead of paying the Genoese captain for the access.
Fixed a bug during Eva's quest in the beggining of the French campaign that allowed marauders to attack and kill even those soldiers who have already retreated.
Fixed a long list of issues with incorrect names, stats and items for allies in both Italian campagins.
Fixed a bunch of various bugs during the MIddle Man quest in Venice.
Fixed a whole bunch of other smaller issues.
Fixed a very long list of problems and errors in Chinese, Japanese and some of the European localizations.

tags.feature: Introduced another test fix for the Maidstone blacksmith's questline's infinite loop issue.
Added a bunch of new recruitable mercenary companies to the doge's campaign, updated the order in which they become available.
Added some more ocult trinket spawns to the Benandanti family crypt; serpent pendant now too can be used during that quest.

tags.balance_change: Lowered the experience bonus for completing the Maidstone's crafting questlines (aclhemist, craftsman, armorsmith).

Changed the enemy spawns for pitched battles against coalition armies in the doge's campaign. Now, instead of only knights, the will also be a bunch of lower tier enemies - men-at-arms and crossbowmen. The spawns will be further reworked once additional enemy art is finished.

During the last chapter of the doge's campaign, Tarrare's assassinations now will take place before the chapter end instead of after, allowing you to still win if you ordered an assassination of the last enemy leader.
Lowered base cooldown for Foot trip and Fist to the face attacks. Foot trip now will always apply the knocked down effect (if the target is not resistant to it).

notes.title: Sins of the Floating City — Now Available! + Patch 2.6
notes.content:
[previewyoutube="I0jVrLytCLA;full"][/previewyoutube][h3]Hello everyone![/h3][h3]We are excited to announce the release of Sins of the Floating City — the fourth DLC for Heads Will Roll: Reforged.[/h3][p]
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3857000/Heads_Will_Roll_Reforged__Sins_of_the_Floating_City/"][/dynamiclink][/p][h2]What awaits you in the DLC: [/h2][p][b]*No step too far, no measure too desperate[/b][/p][p]Become the right hand man of the Venetian Doge and plunge headlong into the maelstrom of European politics to help Venice survive the onslaught of an alliance of its many rivals. Enlist the help of allies and defeat your enemies on the battlefield or, through cunning intrigues and sophisticated machinations, set them against each other in order to reap the fruits of their discord. Deception, betrayal, bribery and political assassinations - achieve your goal by any means available and dare to take the most desperate steps for the sake of the greatness of Venice.[/p][p][b]*A descent into darkness[/b][/p][p]Enter the service of an influential Italian noble house, surrounded by enviers and grudge-bearers, and take on the role of a bodyguard who will protect its members from the dangers that lurk everywhere and the traps set by their enemies. Descend into darkness as you make your way through the Venice's underworld that will confront you with powerful secret societies, mysticism, blood feuds and the many vices and sins of human nature.[/p][p][b]*More than a dozen new characters[/b][/p][p]From members of various Italian noble houses and famous condottierros to the emperor of the Holy Roman Empire himself.[/p][p][b]*Europe-spanning adventure[/b][/p][p]Visit Italy, France, Holy Roman Empire and the Outremer all within one continuous campaign.[/p][p][b]*2 new romantic interests[/b][/p][p]Each with their own unique story and character.[/p][p] [/p][h2]Patch 2.6[/h2][p]Alongside the expansion, we are releasing a major update that is available to all players for free.[/p][p align="start"][b]List of key changes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Enemy knights have received additional armor slots, as well as the ability to switch weapons in combat by drawing a sword from its scabbard. Their base weapon pool has been reworked in favor of heavier weapons (one-handed swords are now only secondary weapons).[/p][/*][*][p]New trinkets and weapons have been added. A number of old trinkets and items have been reworked.[/p][/*][*][p]Added automatic target choice for the attack if there is only one enemy present.[/p][/*][*][p]Added active abilities for some trinkets and items (gauntlet punches, melee attacks for daggers, foot trips with shoes, etc.).[/p][/*][*][p]Some enemy characters will now have high or low virtue. It will affect their equipment, weapons, and abilities.[/p][/*][*][p]Throwing daggers have been reworked and can now also be used for melee attacks. When thrown, their damage increases from Coordination, but in melee, it increases from Agility.[/p][/*][*][p]Added virtue based damage scaling for more weapons. Enemies will now also receive the corresponding bonus.[/p][/*][*][p]Added two new civil talents – Drillmaster and Bon Vivant. A number of old talents have been reworked.[/p][/*][*][p]A number of balance changes have been made to the Kingdom of London section: reduced gold bonuses from battles, added army upkeep costs, changed the ransom price for some of the prisoners, added desertion and troop disband mechanics, and fixed a number of bugs.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a dynamic upper cap for the virtue and its reduction in certain situations (doing highly unvirtuous actions).[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked some of the attacks for various weapons. The Executioner's Axe and the Venetian Falchion have received additional unique strikes.[/p][/*][*][p]Shield bashes, pommel strikes, and other similar actions now have a stamina\\fatigue penalty for missing. The base stamina cost for these actions has been increased.[/p][/*][*][p]A clean hit on the target with the "Weak Spot" strike now additionally increases damage by 5 for every unit of weapon length (5 bonus damage for short swords, 10 for longswords, 15 for two-handed).[/p][/*][*][p]The special attack of curved swords now has an Agility multiplier of 100%, instead of 50%.[/p][/*][*][p]Virtue equal to zero or lower now extends the duration of applied bleedings by 1 turn and increases the severity of inflicted injuries by 2.[/p][/*][*][p]Helmet can now be removed in combat, returning the cut stats.[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked the High Scores menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked the crafting recipes unlocked by the "do-it-yourself" talent. Items like a blacksmith's hammer or a utility knife will now be reusable.[/p][/*][*][p]Major changes have been made to the survival mode: the shop and rewards for completing waves have been reworked, the variety of available items and goods has been increased, the enemy difficulty curve has been made smoother, and additional rewards for quickly killing enemies have been added.[/p][/*][*][p]Applying poison to weapons, bolts, and daggers has been simplified (it can now be done directly from the inventory or a pouch).[/p][/*][*][p]Added new sounds for bludgeoning weapons.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a weapon blessing mechanic for high-virtue characters.[/p][/*][*][p]Armor- and shield-piercing bolts can now be used with all types of crossbows.[/p][/*][*][p]The snapshot mechanic for crossbows has been removed and replaced with a "point-blank shot" – less dependent on the crossbow skill, and increasing the chance to hit and bypass armor, but requiring the target to be stunned.[/p][/*][*][p]The Assassin's Crossbow can now be fired from the left hand without spending a turn (provided the character is armed with a one-handed weapon and does not have a shield).[/p][/*][/list][p]Also added a very long list of large and small balance changes, as well as numerous bug fixes.[/p][p][/p][h2]Special Offer.[/h2][p]To celebrate the release of the new expansion, all previous DLCs are now 50% off. And, at the request of players, we’ve created a separate bundle that allows you to purchase any missing DLCs with an additional 10% discount.

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/58545/every_DLC_with_a_discount/"][/dynamiclink]If you’ve been waiting for the best opportunity to grab the game, now is the time: the base game is 75% off.[/p][p]Alternatively, you can pick up the Complete Edition, which includes absolutely all available content to date — at the biggest discount ever.
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/687800/Heads_Will_Roll_Reforged/"][/dynamiclink][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/35159/Heads_Will_Roll__Complete_Edition/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

tags.feature: Enemy knights have received additional armor slots, as well as the ability to switch weapons in combat by drawing a sword from its scabbard. Their base weapon pool has been reworked in favor of heavier weapons (one-handed swords are now only secondary weapons).
New trinkets and weapons have been added. A number of old trinkets and items have been reworked.
Added automatic target choice for the attack if there is only one enemy present.
Added active abilities for some trinkets and items (gauntlet punches, melee attacks for daggers, foot trips with shoes, etc.).
Some enemy characters will now have high or low virtue. It will affect their equipment, weapons, and abilities.

tags.balance_change: Throwing daggers have been reworked and can now also be used for melee attacks. When thrown, their damage increases from Coordination, but in melee, it increases from Agility.
Added virtue based damage scaling for more weapons. Enemies will now also receive the corresponding bonus.

tags.feature: Added two new civil talents – Drillmaster and Bon Vivant. A number of old talents have been reworked.

tags.balance_change: A number of balance changes have been made to the Kingdom of London section: reduced gold bonuses from battles, added army upkeep costs, changed the ransom price for some of the prisoners, added desertion and troop disband mechanics, and fixed a number of bugs.

tags.feature: Added a dynamic upper cap for the virtue and its reduction in certain situations (doing highly unvirtuous actions).

tags.balance_change: Reworked some of the attacks for various weapons. The Executioner's Axe and the Venetian Falchion have received additional unique strikes.
Shield bashes, pommel strikes, and other similar actions now have a stamina\fatigue penalty for missing. The base stamina cost for these actions has been increased.
A clean hit on the target with the "Weak Spot" strike now additionally increases damage by 5 for every unit of weapon length (5 bonus damage for short swords, 10 for longswords, 15 for two-handed).
The special attack of curved swords now has an Agility multiplier of 100%, instead of 50%.
Virtue equal to zero or lower now extends the duration of applied bleedings by 1 turn and increases the severity of inflicted injuries by 2.
Helmet can now be removed in combat, returning the cut stats.

tags.feature: Reworked the High Scores menu.
Reworked the crafting recipes unlocked by the "do-it-yourself" talent. Items like a blacksmith's hammer or a utility knife will now be reusable.

tags.balance_change: Major changes have been made to the survival mode: the shop and rewards for completing waves have been reworked, the variety of available items and goods has been increased, the enemy difficulty curve has been made smoother, and additional rewards for quickly killing enemies have been added.

tags.feature: Applying poison to weapons, bolts, and daggers has been simplified (it can now be done directly from the inventory or a pouch).
Added new sounds for bludgeoning weapons.
Added a weapon blessing mechanic for high-virtue characters.
Armor- and shield-piercing bolts can now be used with all types of crossbows.

tags.balance_change: The snapshot mechanic for crossbows has been removed and replaced with a "point-blank shot" – less dependent on the crossbow skill, and increasing the chance to hit and bypass armor, but requiring the target to be stunned.
The Assassin's Crossbow can now be fired from the left hand without spending a turn (provided the character is armed with a one-handed weapon and does not have a shield).

Hello!
New localizations have already been added and are currently undergoing testing. All of them will become available on September 4th.
Italian has also been included in the final list of localizations. In the future, we will strive to add even more.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42148793/44974e897226085f55cd94398be04c56c24c70d8.jpg[/img]

So, the final list is:
* French
* German
* Spanish
* Portuguese (Brazil)
* Polish
* Japanese
* Simplified Chinese
* Italian

Earlier we mentioned that the new localizations would be available through a separate branch of the game, however, we have decided to abandon this idea. From a technical standpoint, it would be too difficult to maintain two separate game branches simultaneously due to engine limitations. This would only create additional problems.

However, all [u]localizations[/u] will still be available in [u]beta mode[/u]. This simply means that the text may contain typos and contextual inaccuracies. It will take some time to fix all possible issues. Some players have already volunteered to help with testing, for which we are truly grateful.

See you soon!

notes.title: King's Route Content Expansion + New Girl and Patch 2.07
notes.content:
Hello guys!
I'm happy to inform you that the game has been updated to the version 2.07.

It is one of biggest patches we've done: it totally reworks the king's route and converts it into a full scale kingdom management simulator that allows you to personally control pretty much every aspect of life of the realm under your control. Create new laws, collect taxes, establish your authority, capture and defend territories, build and supply armies - and wage military campaigns both within England and abroad. The new version of the king's route adds so much possibilities that it is now basically a game within a game.

On top of that this update also introduces a new love interest and properly concludes Alyssa's storyline with several possible outcomes that will see her both get everything that she ever desired and receive the ultimate punishment for what she has done.

[b]Changelog:[/b]
1. Totally reworked the king's route into a 4-chapter long kingdom management simulator with several possible endings.
2. Added a new love interst.
3. Added 13 new achievements.
4. Reworked the stats of several high-tier armor pieces (i.e. Nobleman's armor etc. - they now have considerably higher torso cover).
5. Added blackjack and lockpicks to Raoul of Aragon's dropped loot.
6. Increased HP recover from Red stone ring to 2.
7. Lowered the chance to damage armor on a reflected strike.
8. Fixed a bunch of bugs and localization issues.

With this patch done, I will begin the work on the 4th DLC - it should be officially announced in June.
Grace and Glory route expansion is still planned but will most likely take place either after the 4th DLC or together with it (unlikely but might happen).

The 4th DLC itself will introduce an Italian campaign, a yet another expansion to the combat system with new active abilities for trinkets and weapon-swapping for enemies and much more.

As always - big thanks to everyone who reports the bugs and helps me fix them - your cooperation is greatly appreciated. Sorry to everybody who's been affected by the technical issues. If you need any help - don't be afraid to reach out to me directly either here or on [url=https://discord.gg/KWt8RC9Ycc]Discord[/url] and I will try to help you if I can.

Cheers!

For a while I also had an idea of doing some kind of "Stories from Cambrai" DLC that would significatly expand the first half of the game (Cambrai arc) in order to make it less linear and introduce various new questlines, paths and probably even characters - but honestly I'm not 100% sure whether that idea is worth basing a whole DLC around it.

notes.title: Technical patch 2.03
notes.content:
Hello guys!
I'm happy to inform you that the game has been updated to the version 2.03. This is a technical update that is aimed primarily at fixing bugs and dealing with some balancing issues.

[b]Changelog:[/b]
1. Fixed the buggy interaction with the wandring knight\crusader when they attempt to join your party.
2. Fixed the issue with Virtue not falling lower than -10 (now it should go down to -200).
3. Fixed a rare bug in the Maidstone tavern brawler fights where the enemies sometimes became invisible.
4. Lowered the stats of assassins in Rouen (kept them as they are in Prestige mode though). This even will be further updated in the future content patches.
5. Fixed the issues with Knights Last Hope and Justice Sword incorrectly applying bonus damage from player's virtue.
6. Fixed the broken travelling cloak DIY craft.
7. Ending 26 should now correctly trigger Eva's marriage achievement for those who have the first DLC.
8. Fixed a lot of issues with Burgundian polehammer's incorrect moveset, missing tooltips etc.
9. Maces' Batter and Overhead strike attacks now ignore a percentage of target's armor equal to the third of attacker's strength. Smite attack also ignores armor but equal to the half of attacker's strength. Maces now longer have an increased injury chance.
10. Fixed the issue with 'Back' button in Character tab in the Kingdom fo London section sometimes breaking the game.
11. Fixed the issue with the 'lifetime_killed_enemies' error message popping up for some players.
12. Fixed the issue with the player still being able to treat injuries for free in the first chapter of the French campaign.
13. Updated the formula for enemies' armor bypass calculation which should result in player's armor working more reliably and blocking more attacks.
14. Fixed a bunch of issues with inconsistent visual numbers for prices with the Haggler talent and economic zones enabled.
15. Fixed the bug with the wolf's teeth necklace prolonging bleeds by 9 turns instead of 0.
16. Battle blessings no longer reset after the first combat encounter and instead only disappear when the player is back in camp.
17. Lowered the threshold for low virtue punishment for the Man of God civic talent.
18. Fixed the issue that allowed the player to keep assembling forces in Windsor even after the earl relieved him of command.
19. Reworked Parrying dagger trinket. It now provides guaranteed evasion charges based on players' coordination.
20. Attempted for fix the issue with Wallace's claymore unlock not working for some players.
21. Added automatic enemy model update in case of accidental shield drop injury triggering.
22. Fixed the issue with enemies who were not supposed to have poison shield on spawning with it anyway.
23. Updated injury application mechanic in camp. Now there should no longer be situations where two events that apply penalties for untreated injuries trigger simultaneously one after another. Same with toxicity penalty for searching too many bodies - the penalty-applying even should only trigger right after it if there's no more time left in chapter. Otherwise it should automatically be postponed, giving the player a chance to heal themselves.
24. Fixed the issue with the wanted poster losing its value due to new economic zones mechanic. Now it should always sell for full price.
25. Community-made characters will now start with level 5 and should level up on par with other recruitable characters. Their equipment, however, will not update automatically.
26. Fixed a lot of other smaller issues and incorrect interactions.
*Keep in mind that some of the item\mechanics changes will take effect at the start of a new playthrough

[h3]What's next?[/h3]
As previously promised, my next goal is to release a couple of content updates for the Threads of Destiny DLC that will make its scope even bigger. Most likely there will be three updates in total, each dedicated to its own story branch. The first update should be arriving sometime around the end of January.

As always - big thanks to everyone who reports the bugs and helps me fix them - your cooperation is greatly appreciated. Sorry to everybody who's been affected by the technical issues. If you need any help - don't be afraid to reach out to me directly either here or on [url=https://discord.gg/KWt8RC9Ycc]Discord[/url] and I will try to help you if I can.

Cheers!

notes.title: Bugfixing patch 2.02b and the Roadmap
notes.content:
Hello guys!
I'm happy to inform you that the game has been updated to the version 2.02b.

Changelog:
1. Fixed the issue with Numbing Remedy being unavailable for use from the pouch menu in battle and also causing a glitch when used out of battle.
2. Fixed a bug with stats loss\randomization from the lucky dice.
3. Fixed the issue with the recruitable hunter in Rouen having increasingly negative stats (I'm not 100% sure that the issue is totally resolved - let me know if it continues to happen).
4. Fixed several issues for game freezes in battle and in shop.
5. Expanded the list of DIY crafts.
6. Fixed the issue with Acrobat, Woodsman and Haggler civic talents sometimes being invisible during random character creation.
7. Fixed a bunch of smaller issues. glitches and incorrect interactions.

With this patch out of the way and the game being in a pretty stable state (of course I'm going to jinx it) I intend to take a couple of weeks off. During that time I will still monitor the situation and, if something really urgent happens, will come up with new hotfixes. Once my short break ends I plan to being the work  on creating several free content updates that will expand the third DLC - primarily Grace and Glory campaign and the King's route. If everything works out, the first update should arrive around the end of January.

Once those updates are done I plan to start the work on the promised Italian campaign which should arrive (together with the Outremer\Emma's expansion) as its own DLC - probably the last one I will do for Heads Will Roll.

These are my plans. Obviously, nothing I wrote here is set in stone and anything is subject to change. However I'm pretty sure that this will more or less be the way that things will happen in.

As always - big thanks to everyone who reports the bugs and helps me fix them - your cooperation is greatly appreciated. Sorry to everybody who's been affected by the technical issues. Unfortunately it is what it is - the game is absolutely huge and maintaining its technical state alone is very hard. If you need any help - don't be afraid to reach out to me directly either here or on [url=https://discord.gg/KWt8RC9Ycc]Discord[/url] and I will try to help you if I can.

Happy New Year everybody and Merry Christmas!

notes.title: Threads of Destiny DLC is out now! + Patch 2.0
notes.content:
Hello, everyone!

[h3]We are very happy to announce that the third DLC for Heads Will Roll: Reforged — Threads of Destiny — is out and is available for purchase with 15% discount![/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3172940/Heads_Will_Roll_Reforged__Threads_of_Destiny/

The base game - [b]Heads Will Roll: Reforged[/b] - is also available for purchase with a 55% discount for a limited time.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/687800/Heads_Will_Roll_Reforged/

[h3]About "Threads of Destiny"[/h3]
Threads of Destiny massively increases the game's scope with three additional expansions.

The first one of them is the long-awaited [b]French Campaign[/b] - an epic adventure of gargantuan proportions that will take the player on a journey across the entire kingdom of France with 5 new chapters of story content. It is by far the largest campaign in the game and it is filled to the brim with new characters to meet, foes to defeat and challenges to overcome.

The second new addition is equally as anticipated as it finally allows the player to properly complete their ultimate journey from a peasant to a king. With the [b]expansion to the English campaign[/b] Threads of Destiny enables you to finally shake off the shackles of loyal servitude to King Edward and isntead usurp his throne. Create, protect and manage your own kingdom in order to see it either prosper and thrive - or collapse into obscurity.

The third new campaign will open before the player yet another career door. With Threads of Destiny you will now be able to [b]become a bounty hunter[/b]. Join Grace and Glory on their adventures and see if the three of you can build a true camaraderie that will stand any test... Or get blinded by the glitter of gold and end up betraying each other over a lump sum of money.

As always, together with the DLC we are releasing a major patch that will update the game to version 2.0.
That patch will be avilable for free for all the players.

[h2][b]New stuff in Patch 2.0:[/b][/h2]
1. NPC models will now be automatically updated if a character's shield is broken.
2. Endurance now provides a possibility of recovering twice as much stamina.
3. Coordination now is responsible for resisting stuns and throwing weapons' accuracy.
4. Agility no longer provides a bonus to hit chance.
5. Every injury a character has amplifies the damage that they receive.
6. Feint's blind debuff accuracy and evasion value is doubled.
7. Added new rare recruitable allies of unique classes that can only be encountered during special events.
8. Player squad members will now occasionally react to player's bahviour and either approve or disapprove of it resulting in various events and interactions.
9. A lot of trinkets have been reworked. Several new ones have been added.
10. New scavenging events have been added.
11. Fixed a bunch of errors in localization.
12. Some of the enemy encounters will result in ambushes with enemies being the first to take their turn and player suffering a stamina debuff (in Prestige mode).
13. Added 12 new weapons and 2 new shields.
14. The majority of civic talents have been reworked. Several new ones have been added - some of them granting access to unique items and interactions.
15. A lot of weapons have been reworked - their stats and movesets have been changed in order to create more various opportunities for damage scaling.
16. Added a couple of new events and interactions into the first half of the game.
17. Completing quests now earns the player experience points that are used to unlock new civic talents. Talent upgrade points are now longer granted automatically at the start of each chapter.
18. Having very high or very low virtue will now sometimes result in the player character automatically picking certain options in dialogues that suit their behavior.
19. Prestige mode will now have economic zones - depending on who you're trading with the prices in shops will be influenced by your reputation or Prestige.
20. Bonus items appearing in shops will now too be dependant on either reputation or Prestige, depending on who you're trading with.
21. Ultra high virtue will now enable the player to receive battle blessings temporarily improving their preformance in battle.
22. Prestige mode now has a bit more time in chapters.

This DLC and patch are the results of incredibly hard work and we very much hope that it will prove to be a nice Christmas present for all of you.
Thanks you very much for playing!

HWR's Discord: https://discord.gg/xndPrtZMeT

notes.title: HWR: Reforged — Threads of Destiny. New DLC announcement and release date
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42148793/5fff7f9681a22ffb6144873f7a22a5f147b48de5.png[/img]

Hello guys!

We are happy to finally make an official announcement of Heads Will Roll: Reforged's third DLC — Threads of Destiny. It is scheduled to be released on [b]November 28th[/b] and will massively expand the game with four new story branches. As always, the DLC will be accompanied by a major patch that will bring along lots of various additions, reworks and improvements as well as a considerable amount of new content for the base game.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3172940/Heads_Will_Roll_Reforged__Threads_of_Destiny/

[b]So, what to expect?[/b]

[h2]1. New story branches[/h2]
Threads of Destiny will add four new story branches allowing the player to have even more freedom in choosing their own path. Defecting to the French side, joining Grace and Glory on their head-hunting adventures, offering your mercenary services to the lords of Italian city-states or seizing the English crown for yourself and completing the ultimate journey from a peasant to a king — lots of possibilities that were previously only hinted at will now become completely viable options filled to the brim with new adventures, characters and dangerous challenges.

[h2]2. Combat system overhaul[/h2]
The combat system is going to receive a huge overhaul with all character's stats being rebalanced and new various bonuses introduced. The majority of existing weapons will have their movesets expanded with new attacks, many of them scaling from character's stats or through other conditions. At the same time, some other weapons and weapon classes, that were previously too well-rounded, will be tweaked a bit to better reflect their realistic advatages and disadvantages.
Together with that, the game's arsenal of weapons, items and trinkets will be seriously expanded by all kinds fresh additions.

[h2]3. New interactions with allies[/h2]
Members of the player squad will now start to more regularly interact with the player, responding to his behaviour in a positive or negative manner. Hiring honourable knights and crusaders and then commiting unvirtuous actions (or hiring thungs and criminals and then behaving like an upstanding christian) will naturally spark a discontent among your men leading to arguments, desertion or maybe even something worse. On the other hand - performing actions that will resonate with the members of your squad will make them train and fight harder or go out of their way to aid you in unexpected ways.
These interactions will also extend to the combat sections with allies now being able to hand you over various items - spare shield or weapon if yours is broken, a couple of extra crossbow bolts if you ran out of ammunition or a specific consumable item if you're in need of one.

[h2]4. Improved civic talent system[/h2]
The overall structure of the civic talent system will remain the same, however it will receive a number of important improvements. The majority of civic talents will be reworked, generally becoming more potent and effective. The upgrade points, on the other hand, will be harder to come by, giving more important to the player's choice of talents.

[h2]5. Proving Grounds[/h2]
The patch accompanying the DLC will also introduce public access to the Proving Grounds - a special game mode that allows the player to create a custom character with a specific set of stats and items and then duel against various enemies.

[h2]6. Bugfixes[/h2]
And lastly, as always, the update will bring a long list of bugfixes for various issues.

These are the key elements of the upcoming update but the whole list of changes and additions is far from over. We are very much looking forward to release and hope that you are too!
For more information on all things Heads Will Roll — or to get in touch with us — head over to our [url=https://discord.gg/xndPrtZMeT]Discord[/url].

Stay tuned!
1917 Studios

notes.title: Caribbean Legend Patch 1.3 and Black Mark DLC!
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/35094948/4a1a3a9e5a169d8bc75bce7cc840d9c3d88e5ba7.jpg[/img]
[h2]Ahoy![/h2]
The perfect moment to start playing Caribbean Legend!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2230980/Caribbean_Legend/

[h3]First, the important stuff:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Patch 1.3 is available. We've never done anything like this before as a studio.
[*] Starting NG is not required. We recommend loading version 1.2.1 saves made while on land.
[*] Today marks the game's second 'release'—Steam will be actively promoting it for two weeks.
[*] To celebrate, we've set a historic low price—50% off.
[*] Now's the perfect moment to start playing if you’ve been holding off for any reason.
[*] Black Mark DLC is out now.
[/list]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3162620/Caribbean_Legend/

[h2]What's New:[/h2]
[h3]Ships[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44649887/307e7522e668ce62f89348885e84606da24a1de1.jpg[/img]
One of the goals of Patch 1.3 was not only to rework the remaining player-favorite early-game ships but also to lay the groundwork for the planned boarding scenes. The ships turned out great.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44649887/f9a4a0cea4b46e9f2b2a8c0803905c7c7730d88e.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44649887/bb92a57554e44b12040ec97b23b705dd42f743b5.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44649887/904dea0020e94ef30c83e5f96fd03e89ff0ad0c5.jpg[/img]

[b]New ships:[/b]
[list]
[*] The Valkyrie
[*] The Meifeng
[*] Fluyt
[*] War Schooner
[*] The Principio (DLC)
[*] Improved sail and rigging quality for all ships in the game.
[/list]
[b]In total, ~30% of the entire game fleet has been revamped by 1.3 - just as planned.

[/b]
[h3]Quests[/h3]
[b]Extinguished Star[/b]  
We’ve never created a quest this complex, non-linear, and intricate before. It has everything: new content with Mary and Helen, direct impact on the main storyline, cutscenes, crazy flashbacks, and valuable loot. The quest starts at the end of "The Dutch Gambit" and continues through to "Turtle Soup." No spoilers—see it for yourself.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44649887/a472df15e0ab759ef50f801b5a45c4d4a545d29f.jpg[/img]
[b]Black Mark[/b]  
A non-linear quest, designed for the early stages of the game, offering valuable rewards and nods to veterans of the "Sea Dogs" series. Available in both Story and Sandbox modes. Part of the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3162620/Caribbean_Legend/]"Black Mark" DLC[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44649887/796fd6ecd8b2b719e464bd73408bc40d34bb7a73.jpg[/img]

Rewards include: a duelling double-barreled pistol, an Italian rapier, an Army broadsword, a Black Spot ward, armor, as well as a new officer—Tommy Irons, and the legendary Pink of Nicholas Sharp, the Principio. The Pink is stunning, but the true star of the DLC is Irons. He's got killer jokes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44649887/d545d1771d658c07e40bc27ef4d1199bd431430d.jpg[/img]

[h3]Locations[/h3]
No new locations in this patch, aside from a few scenes for the Longway quest. The boarding decks took up almost all of our time and will continue to do so. All four decks will be included in either Patch 1.3.1 or 1.5.

However, we did update several old locations, especially those that significantly lagged behind the newer ones in quality.

[b]Locations update:[/b]
[list]
[*] Locations and scenes for the "Extinguished Star" quest
[*] The Old Lighthouse
[*] Port Royal Lighthouse
[*] Several beaches
[*] Indian village
[*] Improved ground textures in towns.
[/list]
[h3]Animations[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44649887/36b1932a71befa4a87eb7439eedaca35da3942c4.jpg[/img]

We continue the challenging journey of bringing quests, battles, and cities life to life. The minimum program has already been fulfilled, and with Patch 1.5, we aim for something even more ambitious. Next-gen is just around the corner.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44649887/e4bdffc817a9eb257c9536c1644f9a512ff418fc.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44649887/32b3abee4fefa81358db7f09516da43afe7b9ac2.jpg[/img]

[b]New animations:[/b]
[list]
[*] Unique animations for the "Extinguished Star" quest
[*] 7 new contextual death battle animations
[*] 2 prayer animations in churches
[*] 2 animations for drunks in towns
[*] Tavern musicians no longer drown out the game’s music
[*] Fishermen, blacksmiths, and musicians now work according to the time of day
[/list]
[h3]New Hero[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44649887/a375d3c2abd77a20c37084c2a8bc49aa3722312d.jpg[/img]
Due to popular demand, Helen McArthur is now a fully-fledged character in Sandbox mode. She is compatible with the "Vile Little God" and "Black Mark" DLCs. She has unique dialogues in her hometown Blueweld, unique achievements, loot, and starts her pirate career on a war schooner.

For now, she doesn’t carry a musket or visible armor, and there may be some "gender errors" :rofl_pirate: in the dialogues. Her development will continue in Patch 1.5, along with other Sandbox characters.

[h3]Notification System[/h3]
Traditionally, games in this series have never been known for being player-friendly or transparent, often requiring guides. What happened to my character? Why did I fail a dialogue check? What reward did I just receive? Any game needs to communicate with the player—and now Caribbean Legend does. [b]I consider this the key feature of Patch 1.3.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44649887/c13339c8118c46e9dc4c5857f4806724ec1d7a87.jpg[/img]
[b]New notifications:[/b]
[list]
[*] Over 100 new format notifications on sea, land, and in dialogues
[*] Combat statuses—from poisonings to critical damage
[*] Loot markers—so far, only for plants in the jungle, but this is just the start
[*] Quest navigation—so far, only for the beginning of the game
[*] More quest markers over characters and on the global map
[*] New tutorial videos for core game mechanics
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44649887/94b2f240c1ea990df3ecd70c7b5d4445dcb450c1.jpg[/img]
[h3]Interface[/h3]
Let’s be honest, we have the best interface. But somehow, the list of fixes for it has already stretched to three pages. :rofl_pirate: The first half of the first page finally made it into Patch 1.3.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44649887/03c9e371fad5d3f361d9cb22e92d78fd4914f051.jpg[/img]
[b]UI update:[/b]
[list]
[*] Unlimited key remapping—adjust the controls to your liking
[*] Control hints in loot, trade, and exchange windows
[*] Highlighting new entries in the ship’s log and documents
[*] Highlighting available skill points for characters
[*] Keeping the selected character when switching tabs between inventory and skills
[*] Displaying character roles in officer assignment windows
[*] Improved interaction with items in the inventory
[*] Added a DLC button in the menu—if all are purchased, it will be inactive
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44649887/9ff765df6a71eb6a95e65d2b94ca236c3265bc56.jpg[/img]
[h3]Miscellaneous[/h3]
[list]
[*] 13 achievements
[*] New ward
[*] New sword
[*] Automatic crash reports sending - let's see how bad it really is out there
[*] Longway can now carry muskets
[*] New dialogue camera
[*] Missing textures restored for some objects in the "Flying the Jolly Roger" quests
[*] Claude Durand now reliably triggers his loyalty event after a set time
[*] Obtaining a patent removes pirates from the crew
[*] Reputation no longer drops if the player exits "Flying the Jolly Roger" questline before Cartagena
[*] Fewer soldiers in towns, and they stop the player less often
[*] Chance to deceive the guards can no longer exceed 90%
[*] Governors no longer ask you to infiltrate friendly towns
[*] Passengers no longer ask to be taken to hostile towns
[*] "Iron Will" perk no longer allows intimidating officers
[*] Missing item descriptions—skill bonuses, etc.—have been added
[*] Additional optimization of the tutorial on Martinique
[*] Spelling and grammar corrections - thanks to all reports you have been sharing on Discord
[*] Numerous bug fixes
[*] Improved overall game stability
[/list]
[h2]1.5[/h2]
That’s all for now! Over the past six months, we’ve done an incredible amount of work together. We’ve done everything possible and even more. Except for the Story mode epilogue, of course.

We could have done it already, but it would have been too... simple? I want to create something special and worthy of Charles de Maure's story—call it a "director’s cut" of his storyline, if you will. Plus, the game has long needed list of truly new mechanics, fixes for old ones, a complete rebalance, a new loot category, and a proper uplift of Sandbox mode. Not to mention improved controls, gamepad support, Steam Deck experience.

Patch 1.5 will take at least six months, and it will definitely require starting the new game. So for now, we’ll take a short break, rest, and then get back to work.

[b]Leave reviews ːsteamthumbsupː as blue as the Caribbean Sea, download the patch, buy [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3162620/Caribbean_Legend/]the DLC[/url]—and if you’ve been putting off playing the game for any reason, now’s the perfect moment to start![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44649887/9e147e48b319ff4dea3cec3417f5b4966fdf2de1.png[/img]
[i]Coming soon...[/i]

:jollyr:

notes.title: Patch 1.5k and the Roadmap
notes.content:
Hello guys!
I'm happy to inform you that the game has been updated to the version 1.5k. This update brings in both several important bugfixes and a little injection of new content. With this patch out of the way I intend to gradually begin the work on the next big update: the third DLC and an accompanying major patch that will rework stats, civil talents and some aspects of the combat system.
A first look at the third DLC will be available at the time of its official announcement that should happen in August.

Changelog of the patch 1.5k:
1. Lowered the soldier rep requirement for accessing Rennes.
2. Fixed an issue with eneimes sometimes taking infinite turns (often happened in Damanhur).
3. Fixed an issue with player still being able to sometimes die during the French interlude tournament despite the game telling you that it is not lethal.
4. Added another important low virtue event to Maidstone.
5. Completing Roger's quests now gives access to a specialized equipment shop.
6. Added random encounters with Scottish forces during the last chapter of Canterbury campaign and a reward\punishment for completing\not completing them.

notes.title: Not A Hero DLC is out now + Patch 1.5
notes.content:
Hello, everyone!

[b]We are very happy to announce that the second DLC for Heads Will Roll: Reforged — Not a Hero — is out and is available for purchase with 15% discount![/b]

This DLC brings three additional story branches with a total of 7 brand new chapters that will see the player go on all kinds of unexpected adventures. On top of that the DLC also contains the much-awaited squad system rework that includes new visual models for allies, full customization of their equipment as well as an ability to give them orders in battle.
The DLC includes 8 new endings and 14 new achievements.

Complete feature list of the DLC can be viewed on its Steam page or [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/687800/view/4181102761199844328]here.[/url]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2850080/Heads_Will_Roll_Reforged__Not_a_Hero/

To celebrate the release of the DLC, the base game - [b]Heads Will Roll: Reforged[/b] - will also be available for purchase with a 50% discount for a limited time.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/687800/Heads_Will_Roll_Reforged/

In order to complete your bundle you can also purchase [b]"Happily Ever After"[/b] DLC with a 35% discount.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2747080/Heads_Will_Roll_Reforged/

Together with the second DLC we are releasing patch 1.5 with a major gameplay update that, among other things, includes a number of UI/UX improvements.
That patch will be avilable for free for all the players.

[h2][b]New stuff in Patch 1.5:[/b][/h2]
1. Added new difficulty modifier - Prestige mode - that adds weapon durability mechanic, increases the lethality of the combat, lowers the time in chapters and generally makes the game even more hardcore.
2. Added civic talents - a variety of passive abilities that give the character various out-of-battle bonuses.
3. Added hydration mechanic in Outremer. Consuming water in that chapter will now temporarily protect you from the heat fatigue gain.
4. Added Damietta bazaar with a variety of different shops that contain all kinds of items.
5. Added 9 new trinkets including one that counters heat fatigue gain under certain conditions.
6. Survival mode now has a shop where the player can buy and sell items in between rounds.
7. Added keyboard support for in-battle controls.
8. Added quick action buttons to some of the item interaction menus (equipping and unequipping items, selling items and moving items between chest and inventory can be now done with one mouse click).
9. Added trinket presets menu that will allow the player to save several trinket combinations and them quickly swap between them.
10. Added different colors to characters' names in dialogues.
11. Added a couple of new scavenge events.

[b]Balance changes:[/b]
1. Healing injuries will now return only a percentage of the lost characteristics instead of fully restoring them. In Prestige mode you will receive back 50% of the points, on HWR and Hard difficulties - 75%, on Normal and Story difficulties - 100%.
2. Punishments for leaving an injuries untreated have been increased.
3. Mechanical crossbow has been reworked. Operating the crossbow will now require a certain amount of points in craftsmanship and crossbow skill. Repairing and unjamming the drum will now require specific items. Shooting in automatic modes will now generate a recoil that will decrease the accuracy (but is in turn decreased by strength).
Mechanical crossbow's price in manual character creation mode has been increased.
4. Crafting now consumes a tiny bit of time.
5. Item prices have been rebalanced and are overall more expensive now.

[b]Fixes and minor additions:[/b]
1. Field surgery kit will now count as a medical item in Hadley.
2. Beibars will not be able to retreat with a broken leg.
3. Buying recipes from Anna no longer boosts your relationship with her. Relationship bonus points for other quests have been recalculated to add up to 100 if all completed successfully.
4. Fixed a bug with an ally going crazy in a desert cave which resulted in the game crashing.
5. Fixed a bug that could lead to Rennes being captured by the mercenaries despite the city strength score being way higher.
6. Fixed a number of various minor Anna-related issues.

As always, if you enjoy the game - please consider leaving a review on Steam. Make your voice heard.

notes.title: Heads Will Roll: Reforged — Not a Hero. New DLC announcement and release date.
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42148793/735b0bd06dcdb3131c35f88f3e142ccfaaa0d3dd.png[/img]
Hello guys!

We are happy to finally make an official announcement of [b]Heads Will Roll: Reforged's[/b] second [b]DLC — Not a Hero[/b]. It is scheduled to release on [b]May 31st[/b] and — together with accompanying major patch — will bring along a huge amount of new content as well as usher in a considerable overhaul of the game's various systems and mechanics.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2850080/Heads_Will_Roll_Reforged/

So, what to expect?

[h3]1. New story content[/h3]
First of all, the DLC will introduce several new full story branches that will allow the player to take their character's life and career in various alternative directions after the ending of the Cambrai campaign. You will encounter many new friends and foes, go on new adventures, survive new challenges and, of course, face new tough moral choices.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42148793/37c3bf7f3f879908708384a515fc051b1b27a986.jpg[/img]

2. Squad system rework
Then there is a much-awaited squad system rework which includes lots of new visual models, free customization of squadmates' war gear and expanded in-battle controls — with all of that ultimately allowing to perfectly tailor your allies equipment and behavior to suit your desired playstyle. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42148793/4f974d3757cee79a3498c06c7bc5be00ba414741.jpg[/img]

3. Civil talents
Heads Will Roll's RPG elements are too going to get an expansion in the form of civil talents — various non-combat skills and abilities that will allow the player to make their character even more unique. The update will introduce about two dozens of civil talents of ranging magnitude with some of them acting like small pleasant bonuses while others being character-defining traits enabling for a whole playstyle to be built around.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42148793/5fa5e83f1d5a7e51aa5cc9916c3075d7601e13d0.jpg[/img]

4. Prestige mode
In order to freshen up the game experience for the seasoned veterans we will be introducing a Prestige mode — a difficulty modifier that will considerably harden the game: weapons will now also lose durability and eventually break, combat will be much more fast and deadly, injuries - more frequent, time - less plentiful and some of the skill checks - way tougher. Completing the game in this mode will undoubtedly prove to be the toughest challenge yet and will require the player to truly value the character's life.

5. Trinket presets
Considering the major importance of trinkets it is only natural for the player to be in need of oftenly replacing them, swapping around crafting, scavenging, combat and other sets. The upcoming update will finally address this by introducing trinket presets feature that allows to save several desired trinket combinations and then quickly swap between them, removing a lot of unnecessary actions. Together with that, there are also going to be dedicated buttons for instantly unequipping all the trinkets and placing them into inventory or chest.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42148793/0a95a5d8804215dcdc64c6be4d45aade311957e1.png[/img]

6. Interface improvements
Another issue that the upcoming update will be addressing is the cumbersomeness of many of the game's item interaction menus. In order to fix this, the update will be adding quick action buttons allowing to move items between chest and inventory, as well as acquire items from loot in one click. 

7. New gameplay balance
The overall gameplay balance is too going to get a shakeup — buy and sell prices, skill check thresholds, time limits in chapters, item parameters and various other things are going to be updated to freshen up the game and correct some of the existing balancing issues.

8. Bugfixes
And, of course, last but not least — bugfixing. The patch accompanying the DLC will contain a long list of fixes for many of the reported bugs (a detailed list will be provided with the release notes).

As you can see, the scope of the upcoming update is going to be absolutely massive with pretty much all of the game's aspects getting expansions, improvements and overhauls. We are very much looking forward to release and hope that you are too!
For more information on all things Heads Will Roll — or to get in touch with us — head over to our [url=https://discord.gg/xndPrtZMeT]Discord[/url].

notes.title: Happily Ever After DLC is out now + Patch 1.09
notes.content:
Hello, everyone!
[b]We are very happy to announce that the first DLC for Heads Will Roll: Reforged — Happily Ever After — is out and is available for purchase![/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2747080/Heads_Will_Roll_Reforged__Happily_Ever_After/

The DLC brings a lot of new content including marriages with all the girls, new endings, expanded epilogues, new story events, boss fights, Steam achievements and much, much more! Be sure to check it out!
[b][i]Complete feature list of the DLC can be viewed on its Steam page.[/i][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42148793/68e47d29ec058fc77edb28a4c210ed9a94a47843.gif[/img]

Together with the DLC we are also releasing the much anticipated 1.09 patch that brings a ton of bugfixes, reworks and improvements to the game. It is by far the biggest patch the we have done.

[b]1.09 FIxes[/b]
1. Equipped armor items can now be repaired without being taken off.
2. Fixed yet another instance of 'olivia_time_left not defined' bug that caused Olivia's dagger to spawn among unrelated loot and subsequently broke the game, forcing the player back to Olivia's room.
3. Fixed a rare bug that made the player base armor go below zero after unequipping a damaged armor item.
4. Fixed a bug with incorrect equipment loss interaction during the quicksands event.
5. Fixed an issue with incorrect visual hit chances for the spears' 'powerful thrust' attack.
6. Fixed another issue that allowed an enemy to remove the helmet in combat more than once and gain additional stats.
7. Fixed a series of bugs that made combat interface seometimes show incorrect images for player's equipped items.
8. Fixed a bug with incorrect stats reset during manual character creation.
9. Fixed a bunch of issues with system text being shown instead of player's squad members' proper names.
10. Fixed a bug that made repairing squad members' armor and equipment cost zero money.
11. Fixed an issue that made visiting a brothel give zero actual debuffs to the player despite the text saying that it did.
12. Fixed a series of bugs that happened when player attempted to craft poisons through unorthodox recipes.
13. Fixed an issue that prevented some types of poison from being handed over to the sergeant to complete his Hoggard quest.
14. Fixed an issue that prevented certain random events from occuring.
15. Fixed an incorrect interaction with the ornate cloak during the Man of God quest where it wouldn't disappear from inventory after being thrown.
16. Fixed several minor bugs and localization issues.

[b]1.09 Reworks and additions[/b]
1. Added a new ally class — crusaders. They are availalbe for hire in the Outremer chapter (after completing the St. Lazarus quest), have their own visual model and receive no heat debuffs.
2. Added more emotions to the girls' dialogue models (anger, happiness, eyerolls etc.).
3. Improved the accessability of the 'Chest' button.
4. Being in possession of the Justice Sword during the siege of Windsor would result in additional militia bands joining the player's cause.
5. Added a visual indicator to damaged items that are curerntly equipped (in inventory).
6. Axes' description now correctly mentions their improved armor damage chance.
7. Increased the number of enemies at Onar's and Olvier's farms.
8. Added knights and crossbowmen to the pool of Windsor's defenders. Manually completing the siege should be more challenging now.
9. Added a limit to the number of bolts available for purchase to prevent various money-making abuse mechanics.
10. Now after every retreat from Windsor the player will be allowed to loot the killed enemies' weapons and gear.
11. The end game results screen after dying in the French storyline now correctly shows the player's rank (mercenary instead of knight).
12. Increased the speed of durability loss of the mechanical crossbow.
13. Added a new tooltip that describes how the combat stances work and lists all the benefits of each.
14. Updated armor, weapons, trinkets and stats of the Scottish king's bodyguards making them more challenging.
15. Expanded the list of trinkets that can be used by the allies.
16. Increased the starting stats limit in the manual character creating up to 25.
17. Added a new scavenge event.
18. Brough back a softlock prevention mechanic in case the player lost all the weapons and ran out of time before the next story event.
19. Reworked the torture mask yet again — now it only provides bonus vitality for the enemies that had injuries at the moment of death.
20. The cultist leader in York now correcly gains fatigue with every action that he takes.
21. Added a few additional spawns for the Unknown toxin item.
22. The sergeant no longer requires the player to specifically craft him a bag. Now you can both return him the original loot bag that you took from him (or buy a new one of the same size) or craft one yourself.
23. Survival mode now has a limit for the enemies that can spawn with poisoned main weapon — only one per wave (bolts and daggers don't count).
24. Added a 'All to max' button to the manual character creation mode. It will automatically allocate all available points to level various stats.
25. Expanded the list of trinkets availalbe in the manual character generation mode.
26. If the player decides to rest instead of looting — all the members of his squad will too have a portion of their fatigue recovered.
27. Updated a decription of the Wanted poster item — it now mentions that the item only works around Cambrai area.
28. Increased the player's stat bonuses in the Story mode. Made some bosses easier on lower difficulties.
29. Added a switch for enabling\disabling community-made characters.
30. Brought back Northampton's celebratory dialogue after the player's successful capture of Windsor.

Like I said — this patch is the biggest one we've done yet and, together with the first DLC, it would hopefully provide enough new experiences to maybe convice you guys to spend some more time with Heads Will Roll.

The next big update to the game will include a rework of the squad mechanics as well as new visual models for the allies (that will properly depict their class and experience level). Together with that we are also hoping to include in the update an entirely new storyline that will span across several new chapters and take the player on a bunch of new adventures. An official announcement should be coming rather soon so stay tuned!

[b]As always, if you enjoy the game - please consider leaving a review on Steam. Make your voice heard.[/b]

1917 Studios

notes.title: Patch 1.08 — Last Fixes Before New Content
notes.content:
[h1]Patch 1.08 is live![/h1]

This is a smaller patch that is intended to fix a bunch of lesser technical issues.

[b]Changelog[/b]
1. Fixed an issue with player's squad members being able to reload and use crossbows without actually having one in their equipment.
2. Added an automatic crossbow reload in between battles for those player's squad members who have crossbows.
3. Fixed a series of bugs related to armor crafting, including a rare occurance when crafting a new armor piece made it replace the one that you had on right now (same thing with helmets).
4. Reworked Olifant - now it recovers 100% of stamina for the user and his allies instead of a fixed value.
5. Fixed a bunch of various localization issues and several smaller bugs\incorrect interactions.

As you might have noticed this time the changelog is rather small and this is because we're already working on the new content update which should be coming very soon. We are not ready to announce a date yet but if everything goes well you might in for some very pleasant surprise.

Our next stop after that will be the much anticipated squad members rework that will introduce:
-new visual models for the squad members that reflect the character's class and level;
-new in-battle control mechanics that will allow the player to have more control over the ally's behavior in combat;
-new interactions with allies' equipment, allowing the player to give an ally specific weapons\gear to use.

[b]As always — a big thank you to everyone who helps me with finding and fixing bugs![/b]

notes.title: Patch 1.04 — Bugfixes, Balance and More
notes.content:
[h1]Hey guys,[/h1]

[h1]Patch 1.04 is live![/h1]

[b]Fixes[/b]
1. Fixed a bug that made the 4th governor's quest in Damietta zero your reputation with him, preventing you from marrying Emma.
2. Fixed a bug that sometimes caused an error when the player tried to hand over custom armor to the blacksmith.
3. Fixed a bug that made Leper Crusaders have very low HP and also gave them incorrect visual models.
4. Fixed a bug that allowed to infinitely receive an abduction quest in Damietta.
5. Fixed a bug that prevented access to the final quest of Bartholomew's storyline (and thus blocked the related achievement).
6. Fixed a bug that prevented the player from gaining access to the survival mode after completing the game.
7. Fixed a bug that prevented the player from receiving the 'Sword of Justice' achievement.
8. Fixed a bug that allowed gravely wounded enemies to infinitely drop their helmets and receive bonus stats.
9. Fixed rare situations when the lucky coin did not increse the reward for killed enemies.
10. Fixed a bug that made the combat interface glitch out and merge with camp interface preventing the player from progressing.
11. Fixed an error that appeared after the player escaped from Rennes' prison after previously finding Olivia's dagger.
12. Fixed an exploit that allowed to find Olivia's dagger multiple times.
13. Fixed an error that appeared when the player attempted to unjam a mechanical drum with durability below zero.
14. Fixed a bug that sometimes appeared when the player tried to complete Useful Hobby quest.
15. Fixed a bug that made El Mansur tavel menu to give an incorrect fatigue icon.
16. Fixed incorrect visual hit chances for Estoc's Pierce attack.
17. Fixed a bug that prevented the player from gaining access to a trinket for creating all possible bolt types.
18. Fixed inconsistencies with various trinkets' mechanics (torture mask, black stone ring, tarot cards).
19. Fixed a bug that made Anna's shop replace every other shop in the game except for the main one.
20. Fixed a lot (A LOT) of smaller bugs, glitches and localization issues.

[b]Added and changed[/b]
1. Lowered max possbile starting level for recruitable allies.
2. Added a more detailed explaination for Heat mechanic in the desert.
3. Increased Estoc's stats requirements, lowered damage.
4. Increased flail's stats requirements.
5. Increased the amount of items available for sale in Rennes (added more high level armor, shields and weapons).
6. Added medical treatise to the list of items that can help in Hadley quest.
7. Mortifying flesh and playing lute camp actions no longer require player to equip the necessary trinkets (they can work in inventory without being put on).
8. Playing dice will give the gambling bonus without necessarily being equipped (can work from inventory).
9. Lucky coin will give more gold for selling items without being equipped (can work from inventory).
10. Cross pendant and small golden cross now both offer protection from bleedings and poisonings if the player's virtue is high enough.
11. Tainted chalice's effect (prolonging poisonings) increased by 1 turn.
12. Poison dart's effect (increasing the damage of poisonings) increased by 1.
13. Added another resolution to the first Ruffin encounter in case of player's victory.

notes.title: HWR News — New armor system overview
notes.content:
Hello.

As was promised, today I'm bringing you another blogpost with more information about new features that will be introduced in Reforged and Downfall.
This time we will discuss armor.

First of all, let's talk numbers. The overall amount of available armor items has been increased dramatically. At this point the work-in-progress build of the game has 21 body armors, 21 helmets, 20 gorgets\bracers\greaves and several helmet attachments. This is a considerable improvement over the original game and this number is very likely to increase even more as the work is not yet done. Having this many types of defensive equipment will allow the player to deeply customize his character's loadout in order to suit the chosen playstyle or address any particular issue.

[h3][b]New slots[/b][/h3]
This is also helped by the fact that there will be 3 new equipment slots for gorgets (neck armor), bracers and greaves (limbs armor). Thus, even at the earlier stages of the game, the player can obtain a very respectable level of protection. But most of the armor, obviously, comes with various debuffs so it will always be a trade-off between better protection or better combat stats.

[h3][b]Prestige[/b][/h3]
New equipment slots and new armor pieces are also going to have more significance due to the introduction of the Prestige mechanic. The better equipment you've got on - the higher is your Prestige. This, in turn, means better chance to impress people and command their respect. So, if you find yourself doing some diplomatic mission or seeking to make an impression on a noble lady — it may be wise to put aside your trusty but worn chainmail and suit up with something fancier (even if you're not intending to use it on a battlefield).

[h3][b]Combat mechanics[/b][/h3]
When it comes to combat mechanics there's news too. Limbs armor is now a fully separate value; all armor items can now receive separate damage to diffetent armor zones (so, for example, a body armor with limbs protection after absorbing blows to the limbs can lose several points of 'limbs armor' value while 'torso armor' value will remain as it was). The same applies to allies and enemies whose equipment too can take damage to a particular zone.

[h3][b]Manual armor repair[/b][/h3]
During repair the item can lose some stats as well. For example, armor, cover and prestige values will lower when the player attempts to manually repair the item while not being that skilled at craftsmanship. Obviously, the more you level the skill - the fewer stat losses your items will take. Same thing will happen if the player does cheap partial repair through blacksmith. Full repair, on the other hand, might cost a lot higher — but will return your item back with pristine stats.

[h3][b]Armor crafting[/b][/h3]
And now for the most interesting part — armor crafting and custom armor. Yes, both Downfall and Reforged will have armor crafting: player will be able to combine different armor items in order to get an item with higher stats. Unlike consumable crafting system, armor crafting WILL NOT be giving you a predetermined item with a prethough list of parameters but rather will produce you a completely new item with dynamic stats. This means that combining two damaged or two pristine items will not give you the same result. The outcome will also be influenced by your craftsmanship skill. The higher it is — the more bonuses the item will receive (i.e. more armor, more cover, higher sell price, more prestige, fewer debuffs etc.).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42148793/a036d0148438f7c465a5360aabe7eeade5f02936.jpg[/img]

Same goes for the head armor items. Some of helmets too will be able to be combined with each other (bascinet + mail coif, for example) or will take on attachments, like visor or face protection chops.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42148793/6aade7778bb73c3033e7ace3c5e03dd042ad32d0.jpg[/img]

The player won't, of course, be able to combine ANY items — heavy armor (plate mails, full helmets etc.) is not going to be usable in crafting. The crafting system will remain more reasonable and revolve around combining things like a padded jacket and a chainmail or a chainmail and a cuirass or a demi-cuirass and a plackart etc.

So these are the main points when it comes to the new armor system. It took a lot of work to implement and I really hope that it will be a lot of fun for you to use.
In the next blogposts I'm going to do similar overviews for weapons, trinkets, ally-related mechanics and other stuff — so stay tuned for more news.

Cheers,
1917 Studios
